data.name: Nordiczero
data.description: Nordiczero is an early-stage Swedish venture developing solutions that incorporate biochar and bioash from biogenic residues into concrete and building materials. The company aims to lock biogenic carbon into cementitious products for durable storage in the built environment. It has a very small public footprint (one-person team on LinkedIn) and no registry issuances to date.
